period_note: BASIS: CONSOLIDATED, not Solo. This source (the bank's own website newspaper-style quarterly disclosure, a genuinely different and richer source than the annual-report-embedded 'Evaluation of Quarterly Financials' BSEC table previously used for FY2019-2025, which is confirmed exhausted for FY2011-2018 -- no such table exists in any of those years' annual reports) presents ONLY a Consolidated Balance Sheet/Profit and Loss Statement/Cash Flow Statement/Statement of Changes in Equity in every quarter checked FY2011-2018 -- no Solo section is printed in the main 3-panel layout. This is a REAL, PERVASIVE basis mismatch against this dataset's Solo Q4/annual series for all of FY2011-2018 (the whole block newly added this session), matching the same CONSOLIDATED pattern already documented for FY2022/2024/2025's interim quarters (as opposed to the SOLO FY2019-2021/2023 interim quarters) -- see sources.json and insights.json's reporting_basis/data_gaps fields for the full picture across all years. Cross-validated: this file's own figures satisfy Assets=Liabilities+Equity, NII=Interest Income-Interest Expense, Total Operating Income=NII+non-interest income, Profit before provision=TOI-TOE, Profit before taxation=PBP-Total provision, and Profit after taxation=PBT-Tax, all to the exact taka, and the equity components (paid-up capital+statutory reserve+other reserve+retained earnings+minority/non-controlling interest) sum exactly to Total Shareholders' Equity. Cumulative Jan-Sep 2013 Profit after taxation remains negative (-1,131,167,585, EPS -2.21), less negative than the H1 2013 figure (-1,997,793,950), implying a discrete Q3-alone (Jul-Sep) profit of approximately +866.6m -- consistent with the large H1 specific-provision event documented in 2013_Q2.json not recurring in Q3. Retained earnings is negative at this balance-sheet date (-1,139,897,671) as a direct consequence.
